name: Rian
source:
Three years ago, [url=/c124208]Will[/url] found him after he had collapsed on the road, Rian seems to have lost all of his memories and does not remember anything before Will had found him. He is currently in the Einlark mercenary unit led by Will. Since Rian is good-looking, he's popular with the girls in the unit.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20010123101600/http://www.web-giga.com/seihin/win_pure/p_rian.htm]official website[/url].]
